answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a certified orchard season: the holder must finish one season of supervised labor at a registered orchard, verified in person by a licensed agronomist who stamps a copper badge and files the record into a public vault ledger. Agronomist slots are one-on-one and seasons cannot be compressed, so stamping is neither parallelizable nor bulk-buyable. A certification fee in outside money doubles per further identity on the same funding trail, so each extra fake costs another human's whole orchard season, another agronomist day, and twice the prior fee.
